record_title: Weighted-cosine Hadamard bound fails exactly from dimension three
provenance: Numerical-linear-algebra analysis of the weighted-cosine extremal conjecture in Appendix A of arXiv:2609.17947.
limitations: The result treats real orthogonal frames and strictly positive diagonal weights for the weighted-cosine Frobenius objective. It does not characterize the global maximum in dimensions at least three, does not cover complex unitary frames, and does not provide a generally sharp replacement upper bound. It does not invalidate the source paper's exterior-algebraic ACA results or numerical pivoting experiments. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.

artifact_inventory.purpose: Exact symbolic verification of the 3x3 counterexample, the all-dimension extension, the order-four Hadamard gap, and the algebraic identity used in the two-dimensional theorem.
